summary: Tested the new Home dashboard (Performa & Beban Kerja Tim + Kapasitas & Beban Kerja Personel), the accent-card left bar fix, and /api/stats/team. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. I recomputed every series independently from the DB for 7d and 4w, checked WIB bucketing of completed_at, the late/overdue rules, that future deadlines are not counted, on_time/due, the status thresholds, employee scope (people=1), invalid anchor (400) and no auth (401). Controlled TEST_ tasks went into an isolated past week and were deleted by id afterwards. Frontend desktop 1440: everything works. That covers the stat cards (equal to the API summary), the day picker (today selected; clicking a day refetches with the anchor and statuses match), the 7d/4w toggle (4w ticks 12 Okt/19 Okt/26 Okt/2 Nov), the line/bar toggle (.recharts-line vs .recharts-bar), personnel pills, division chips, the 6-card limit with toggle-all expanding to 11, Kirim Pesan going to /messages/conv_..., and Lihat di Kanban opening Board view with the assignee filter (3 cards, matching the 3 active tasks). The accent card has border-left 4px solid on the card element itself and its left edge matches the parent, so there is no white gap. Old perf-calendar, KPI and perf-employee-cards elements are gone. One failure: on mobile 390 the page overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 438).

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile 390: horizontal page overflow, document.documentElement.scrollWidth=438 (>392). Cause: the person-card grid 'mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3' has no explicit column template below md, so the implicit auto column takes the min-content width of the nowrap 'truncate' task titles and person-status pill (column computed as 401px). Cards get clipped on the right ('2 tugas (40...', 'Lihat di Kanba'). I checked it in the browser: setting gridTemplateColumns to minmax(0,1fr) gives scrollWidth=390. Fix: add 'grid-cols-1' (or min-w-0 on PersonCard root).

issues: The legend appears twice: 'Tasks Selesai/Tasks Overdue' above the chart and 'Output Selesai/Overdue' in the footer. That is redundant and the labels don't match; keep one, or use the same labels in both.
KETEPATAN WAKTU shows '0%' when on_time_rate is null (no due tasks, e.g. the employee view). That reads as 0% on time; show '—' instead.
Line chart draws future days (after today) as 0. Consider null for future buckets so the line stops at today.
Widget is still labelled 'Statistik Bulanan' in the WIDGETS map in Dashboard.jsx. Rename it to 'Performa & Beban Kerja Tim'.

action_items: Fix the mobile horizontal overflow in the Personnel card grid: add grid-cols-1 to the grid in MonthlyStats.jsx line 112 (or min-w-0 on the PersonCard root).
Optional: show '—' for null on_time_rate, de-duplicate the chart legend, and rename the 'Statistik Bulanan' widget label.
critical_code_review_comments: team_stats: people[].share is based on all active tasks, including tasks assigned to inactive users. Acceptable, but shares may not add up to 100% across the visible cards.
team_stats loads all active tasks (to_list(20000)) and does per-user filtering in Python. That's fine at the current scale (20 tasks).
